bug_report_content:
Title: Problem with Object Id and Type Id as Wrapper Object (regression in 2.5.1)
State: closed

Description:
(note: originally from https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-module-jaxb-annotations/issues/51)

Looks like fix for #669 caused a regression for the special use case of combining type and object ids, with wrapper-object type id inclusion. The problem started with 2.5.1.

Comments:

[cowtowncoder]: Fixed for 2.6.5 (and, if ever released, 2.5.5-1 micro-patch), as well as `master` for 2.7.0 (-rc3, if one released).
